# 2 Kings 13 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 13 (25 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.3 — "continually" vs. "again and again" vs. "all the days"
- **EMET:** "all the days" / **LOGOS:** "continually" / **PNEUMA:** "again and again"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "continually" — *kol ha-yamim* denotes continuous duration, not intermittent episodes.

---

## V.7 — "like dust at threshing" vs. "like grain on a threshing floor"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "like dust at threshing" / **PNEUMA:** "like grain on a threshing floor"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "like dust at threshing" — Hebrew compares to *'afar* (dust), not grain; PNEUMA adds a referent not in the text.

---

## V.14 — Explanatory gloss in translation text
- **EMET/LOGOS:** preserve phrase as spoken / **PNEUMA:** adds "the same words Elisha himself had cried..."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** the echo to 2:12 belongs in notes, not translation text.

---

## V.21 — "came to life" vs. "came back to life"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "came to life" / **PNEUMA:** "came back to life"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "came to life" — simpler rendering preserves the starkness of Hebrew *vayechi*.

---

## V.3/V.23 — Theological framing (note only)
- All three agents agree that v.23's citation of the patriarchal covenant is the sole explicit reference in Kings. No disagreement in translation; noted for theological significance.

---
*— SOPHIA*
